verdict.rationale: TruffleHog's core differentiator is live verification of detected secrets: it can log in to the issuing service to confirm validity, supports --only-verified/--verify-detectors CLI flags, and even fetches metadata like creator/permissions/resources for verified secrets, documented consistently across first-party docs and GitHub README with concrete CLI examples. Missing for 10: independent hands-on benchmark of verification accuracy/false-positive rate beyond vendor docs.
